ogTitle:
Ronan Farrow on Instagram: "This week, in Elon Musk's lawsuit against Sam Altman and OpenAI, the jury saw video of a sworn deposition from Mira Murati, OpenAI's former CTO. Elaborating on her comments in our latest @newyorkermag story, she alleged that Altman was not always truthful, gave different executives conflicting information, and pitted them against each other. 

Over the course of an 18-month investigation, we traced the yearslong history of these claims from Altman's colleagues, and looked at what this tells us about integrity in AI leadership, and how it affects all of us.

Link in bio to read the full investigation.

#ai #samaltman #openai #elonmusk #news"
